title: Cargo size matters when designing lipid nanoparticles for delivery of large gene editors - Nature Biotechnology
text:
Lipid nanoparticles often show reduced performance when delivering the large messenger RNAs that encode gene editors. Screening ionizable lipids with a gene-editor-sized RNA identified LC-1, which forms a structure that enhances endosomal escape and enables efficient genome editing in the liver, lung and brain of mice.
